title: Space Exploration Quiz
description: Journey through the universe and test your space knowledge!

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun! It's also the smallest planet in our Solar System. ☀️

questions.question: How many moons does Jupiter have?
questions.explanation: Jupiter has at least 79 known moons! The four biggest ones are called the Galilean moons, named after the scientist who discovered them. 🪐

questions.question: What is the name of our galaxy?
questions.explanation: We live in the Milky Way galaxy! It has over 100 billion stars, and our Sun is just one of them. 🌌

questions.question: What is an astronaut?
options: A person who travels to space
questions.answer: A person who travels to space
questions.explanation: Astronauts are brave explorers who travel to space to do experiments and explore! They wear special suits to survive in space. 🚀

questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars is called the Red Planet because it looks reddish due to rusty dust on its surface! Scientists think it might have had water long ago. 🔴
